name: Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. was established in 1989 in Tokyo and creates, develops and runs digital content for smartphones and other devices. Its consumer services include the Booksmart e-book service, the ATIS Traffic Info app and the Women's Diary health app. It also operates Flea-ma.jp, a marketplace for high-value goods, and distributes agricultural and marine products.
